title: An evening update for the shared laundry
titleZh: 共用洗衣間的晚間公告
passage:
A quick laundry update after we rearranged the basement washers yesterday. The ordinary washers in the basement are available until ten, but the large washer there is out of service. In the annex, the attendant has to unlock the large washer for each new load. The room also stays open until ten, but the attendant’s desk closes at eight.

Also, the time on a completion notice is when it reaches your phone, not when the wash ended. The washers kept running during yesterday’s connection failure. When your phone reconnects, it receives any notices held back for it before new ones, starting with the oldest completed load. Each completed load generates just one notice.

About load sizes: towels are fine in an ordinary machine. A bulky, one-piece bed cover needs a large machine, even if you can fold it small enough to fit through an ordinary door.

If a washer fails to start, send us a record of the completed charge and the machine number. Your bank may show a pair of entries with the same amount. In our own payment history, only a completed charge has a receipt number.

As for those delayed notices, the resident in apartment eighteen finished a load during the outage and then started a second load on the same setting. Her phone received no notices during the outage and just one when it came back online. Finally, both of our paper layouts show machine numbers by position. The sheet beside the basement door was printed before the move. The plan on the lobby noticeboard shows the new arrangement.
passageZh:
昨天地下室的洗衣機重新排過位置，這裡有幾項更新。地下室的普通洗衣機可用到晚上十點，但大型洗衣機暫停使用。附館的大型洗衣機每次洗新的一批衣物前，都要請管理員開鎖。附館本身也開到晚上十點，但管理員的服務台八點就關閉。

另外，洗衣完成通知上的時間是手機收到通知的時間，不是機器洗完的時間。昨天連線中斷時，洗衣機仍照常運轉。手機重新連線時，會先收到暫存的通知，再收到新的；暫存的通知從最早洗完的那一批開始。每批只會發出一則通知。

再提醒一下衣物尺寸：毛巾可用普通洗衣機。厚重的一體式床罩要用大型洗衣機，即使折得夠小、塞得進普通機的門口也一樣。

如果洗衣機沒能開始運轉，請把已完成的扣款紀錄和機器編號傳給我們。銀行端可能出現兩筆金額相同的款項。在我們自己的付款記錄裡，只有已完成的扣款會有收據編號。

再說一下延遲通知。十八號公寓的住戶在斷線期間洗完一批衣物，接著以同一個洗程開始洗第二批。她的手機在斷線時完全沒收到通知，重新上線時也只收到一則。最後，兩份紙本位置圖都是根據機器所在的位置列出編號。地下室門邊那份是在調動位置前印的，大廳公告板上的圖才是新配置。
